segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 开源软件与许可证 with a teammate. I use open source to talk about 开源，允许他人查看并按许可证使用源代码. I use software license to talk about 软件许可证，规定软件可以如何使用和分发. I use contributor to talk about 贡献者，为项目提供代码或其他帮助的人. I tell my teammate: Today I use open source, software license, and contributor. At the end, I say: I can use open source clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 社区礼仪 with a teammate. I use Thanks for sharing. to talk about 谢谢你的分享。. I use Could you explain your idea? to talk about 你可以解释一下你的想法吗？. I use Please be respectful. to talk about 请保持尊重。. I tell my teammate: Today I use Thanks for sharing., Could you explain your idea?, and Please be respectful.. At the end, I say: I can use Thanks for sharing. clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 开源贡献规范 with a teammate. I use CONTRIBUTING guide to talk about 贡献指南，说明如何参与项目的文件. I use CODEOWNERS file to talk about 代码所有者文件，指定目录或文件的评审负责人. I use contribution guideline to talk about 贡献规则，项目接受贡献的具体要求. I tell my teammate: Today I use CONTRIBUTING guide, CODEOWNERS file, and contribution guideline. At the end, I say: I can use CONTRIBUTING guide clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 开源贡献规范 with a teammate.
